attackers_goals: Evading security controls and possibly persisting malware.
description: The Service Control command (sc.exe) is used to create, start, stop, query, or delete Windows services. Adversaries may attempt to use the command to execute and persist a binary, command, or script.
investigative_actions: Check whether the service created, or the configuration change to an existing service, is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it.
name: Uncommon Service Create/Config
